scope: Prospective fresh confirmation of a deterministic System 1 request recognizer plus checked Qwen3.5-0.8B Q4_0 unit-output fallback. Separate model-only reporting is mandatory. No Android action is executed.

fresh_cohort.author: Informed synthetic author after final source freeze; no candidate source/test/prompt/output reads, model/gate filtering or oracle-derived labels.
fresh_cohort.review: Manual semantic and exact source/canonical slot review of all100 before any candidate or baseline outputs. Preserve every author attempt and ambiguity resolution. No post-output repair or relabelling.
fresh_cohort.novelty: Opaque exact/normalized prior requests, prompt examples, source fixtures and family/template hashes. Novel wording is not semantic or population independence.

arms.baseline: Original production LocalModel prompt/intent GBNF and selected ModelCommandGate
arms.checked_model: Exact immutable Unit prompt/GBNF with CompatibleUnitCommand.validate
arms.product_pipeline: CompatibleUnitCommand.recognize; only if refused, validate the same captured unit response. Every result records FAST_LOCAL_REQUEST/CHECKED_MODEL/UNKNOWN.
arms.capture_all_requests: Both model arms capture all100 for research, even if the production pipeline would skip inference. Fast local success is never counted as Qwen prediction accuracy.

capture.backend: Pinned existing host C API CPU, no GPU/adapter/callback
capture.memory: Fresh allocated context per request; shared weights
capture.sampling: GBNF followed by greedy, actual canonical JSON and EOG required
capture.order: Baseline then checked-model, serial; record first and subsequent latency separately
capture.failure_policy: Preserve failure/partial outputs; no retry, row omission or partial successful score

qualification.promotion: Passing can qualify the combined pipeline, not a claim that the model-only arm improved without regressions. Exact app integration, tests/package inspection, isolated actual Android replay and real permissioned workflows remain separate requirements.

limitations: Informed correlated synthetic pairs, not blinded, user, population or voice accuracy
Fast local recognition is deterministic code and provides no model activation explanation
Finite scope/vocabulary heuristics can overreject and do not establish arbitrary-language safety
Model-only regressions must remain visible even if the combined pipeline qualifies
Host C API inference is not phone latency, production JNI, NPU or Office Kit evidence
Explain proposal correctness is not answer fulfillment or causal productivity interpretation
No training or mechanistic interpretation result from this experiment
Pre-event research code is not eligible event-written competition code
